extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of early-20th-century fiction (readers of Upton Sinclair)
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter excerpt from Upton Sinclair's The Jungle, presenting narrative scenes of the protagonist Jurgis Rudkus: his encounter with a wealthy youth, subsequent humiliation, arrest, and induction into criminal life. The page is pure fiction and contains no evaluative rubric or guidelines.
